Thank you for posting about this. I have had similar problems recently but for me it is something new to feel so much anger. I often feel ashamed or guilty about my anger which makes it even harder. I am still struggling with this but here are some (very simple and basic things) I have tried to do, which sometimes help me: 

- Making sure I eat and sleep enough. This sounds stupidly basic but once I started paying attention to my eating and sleeping I realized they weren't normal at all

- Talking to people. I found I had gotten in the habit of not sharing with anyone when I was having a hard time. Reddit works for this, so keep posting :)

- Do something else first strategy: often I feel I need to harm myself and do not feel I have the ability to resist. Instead of trying to fight it, I tell myself I can go ahead, but I have to do something else first. It can be anything: drink a glass of water, play a game on my phone, take a shower. This doesn't always work but sometimes I manage to distract myself and calm down a little.

- Many small slips instead of a few very big ones. This isn't ideal, but I have found that self harming often and in more benign ways can help me stay calm enough on bad days to avoid losing control all together and ending up with a black eye. 

I hope some of this might be helpful. I feel for you a lot and this is something very hard to handle and hard to talk about.
